item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-63564b5434ef3b9b","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"The national dialogue began in May 2023 after President Sisi's call, but opposition figures suspended or withdrew because security repression continued and the process was viewed as mismanaged; some participants were targeted, prosecuted, or arrested.","question_ids":["4B.3","4B.10","8B.1","8B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The dialogue and reported withdrawals, targeting, and arrests occurred during 2023; the presidential call preceded the period.","ruler_attribution":"President Sisi initiated the dialogue; AFTE attributes its administration and the continuing repression to Egyptian authorities, while the report does not establish that Sisi personally directed each incident.","limitations":["AFTE is a civil-society monitoring organization and characterizes the process critically."]},{"source_id":"SRC-63564b5434ef3b9b","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"The presidential pardon committee contributed to the release or pardon of more than 1,500 prisoners of conscience, but AFTE reported that security authorities exclusively selected beneficiaries through a selective process lacking governing standards.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.4","3B.5","3B.9","8B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The releases occurred over the approximately year-and-a-half period preceding and including 2023; the selection assessment concerns the 2023 context.","ruler_attribution":"President Sisi reactivated and expanded the committee; AFTE attributes selection control to security authorities.","limitations":["The source does not provide a complete release list or independent audit of selection decisions."]},{"source_id":"SRC-63564b5434ef3b9b","start_unit":4,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"The National Election Authority reduced the number of notary offices available for presidential endorsement forms from 389 in 2018 to 217 in 2023, and AFTE reported that opposition supporters were prevented from completing endorsements through crowds, alleged assaults, electronic-system failures, and ineffective complaint handling.","question_ids":["4B.1","4B.2","4B.4","4B.8","4B.10","7B.2"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The endorsement process and reported restrictions occurred during the 2023 presidential election period.","ruler_attribution":"The NEA and security forces are identified as the relevant authorities; the source does not prove that Sisi personally ordered each restriction.","limitations":["Some accounts rely on AFTE researchers' observations and testimonies; the NEA disputed complaints as false allegations."]},{"source_id":"SRC-63564b5434ef3b9b","start_unit":5,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"AFTE documented at least 140 arrests of Ahmed al-Tantawy's relatives, friends, and campaign members during the 2023 presidential campaign, with charges including joining a terrorist group and spreading false news.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.5","3B.8","4B.1","4B.3","4B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The arrests began in May 2023 and increased during the endorsement and campaign period.","ruler_attribution":"AFTE attributes the arrests to Egyptian security and judicial authorities; it does not establish a personal order by Sisi.","limitations":["The figure is AFTE's documented minimum and the source does not provide a complete case register."]},{"source_id":"SRC-63564b5434ef3b9b","start_unit":5,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"Citizen Lab reported that presidential hopeful Ahmed al-Tantawy's phone was targeted with Predator spyware using a previously unknown zero-day method; Citizen Lab expressed high confidence that the Egyptian government was responsible because Egypt was a known client and one attempt originated inside Egypt.","question_ids":["4B.3","4B.9","7B.6"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The targeting was reported on the 25 September 2023 election-announcement date.","ruler_attribution":"The source attributes the attack with high confidence to the Egyptian government, but does not identify Sisi's personal authorization.","limitations":["The government attribution is an external technical assessment rather than a disclosed official finding."]},{"source_id":"SRC-63564b5434ef3b9b","start_unit":5,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"AFTE documented 23 media incidents containing at least 29 violations in 2023, including arrests, detention, website blocking, referrals to prosecution, bans on appearances, and deletion or suspension of journalistic content.","question_ids":["4B.3","4B.6","4B.9","4B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The incidents occurred during 2023.","ruler_attribution":"AFTE attributes the pattern to Egyptian authorities and the Supreme Council for Media Regulation; personal direction by Sisi is not established.","limitations":["The aggregate count is AFTE's monitoring result and combines different types of incidents."]},{"source_id":"SRC-63564b5434ef3b9b","start_unit":6,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"The Supreme Council for Media Regulation blocked Mada Masr for six months after an investigation concerning a report about possible Palestinian displacement, citing lack of licensing and alleged false news; Mada Masr had changed the headline and apologized for possible misunderstanding.","question_ids":["4B.3","4B.6","4B.9","7B.2"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The investigation, report change, and blocking decision occurred in October 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The decision was made by the Supreme Council for Media Regulation; the source does not establish personal involvement by Sisi.","limitations":["The account presents AFTE's description and the regulator's stated grounds alongside Mada Masr's response."]},{"source_id":"SRC-63564b5434ef3b9b","start_unit":11,"end_unit":13,"fact_summary":"AFTE reported 31 digital-rights incidents involving 38 violations in 2023; more than 73% were politically motivated, including arrests for criticizing economic policies, sharing information contradicting official narratives, and publishing political or satirical videos.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.5","3B.8","4B.3","4B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The incidents and percentage reported cover 2023.","ruler_attribution":"AFTE attributes the arrests and prosecutions to Egyptian security and judicial authorities; it does not establish Sisi's personal involvement in individual cases.","limitations":["The aggregate is based on AFTE's documented cases and coding methodology."]},{"source_id":"SRC-63564b5434ef3b9b","start_unit":13,"end_unit":13,"fact_summary":"Security forces arrested members of the Karama, Dostour, and Nasserist parties in 2023 over social-media activity or posts criticizing the regime, economic conditions, or local conditions; prosecutors ordered continued detention in several cases.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.5","3B.8","4B.3","4B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The arrests and detention orders occurred between March and May 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The source attributes the conduct to security forces and the State Security Prosecution, without proving a personal directive from Sisi.","limitations":["The source reports selected cases rather than all party-related prosecutions."]},{"source_id":"SRC-63564b5434ef3b9b","start_unit":16,"end_unit":16,"fact_summary":"President Sisi pardoned Patrick Zaki the day after an Emergency State Security Misdemeanor Court sentenced him to three years for spreading false news over a 2019 article.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.5","3B.9","7B.7","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The conviction occurred on 18 July 2023 and the pardon the following day.","ruler_attribution":"The pardon is directly attributed to President Sisi; the prosecution and court proceedings are attributed to Egyptian judicial authorities.","limitations":["The pardon removed the sentence but does not itself establish broader correction of the underlying legal or institutional practice."]},{"source_id":"SRC-63564b5434ef3b9b","start_unit":14,"end_unit":15,"fact_summary":"The Ministry of Agriculture cancelled the disciplinary referral of academic Hesham al-Araby after he criticized the disposal of local poultry herds, while other academics faced investigations, salary suspension, dismissal, or barriers tied to political or security considerations.","question_ids":["3B.4","4B.3","4B.4","4B.5","8B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The referral and cancellation occurred in 2023; the other institutional cases were active during the period.","ruler_attribution":"The report attributes the decisions to university, ministry, and security authorities; no personal Sisi directive is shown.","limitations":["The source is based partly on testimonies and advocacy reporting, and the cases involve different institutions."]},{"source_id":"SRC-63564b5434ef3b9b","start_unit":16,"end_unit":16,"fact_summary":"President Sisi pardoned Patrick Zaki after the emergency court sentence, but Zaki had previously spent 22 months in pretrial detention and remained subject to a travel ban that prevented him from resuming studies.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.4","3B.5","6B.8","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The pardon and continuing effects of the prior detention and travel ban were reported in 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The pardon is directly attributed to Sisi; the detention and travel ban are attributed to judicial and prosecutorial authorities.","limitations":["The source does not state whether the travel ban was lifted during 2023."]},{"source_id":"SRC-63564b5434ef3b9b","start_unit":17,"end_unit":17,"fact_summary":"Security forces dispersed a teachers' demonstration on 15 October 2023 and arrested 14 protesters, who were charged with terrorism-related and assembly offenses and held pending investigation until release in February 2024.","question_ids":["3B.5","3B.8","3B.9","4B.3","6B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The dispersal, arrests, and detention began in 2023; the later release falls outside the target period.","ruler_attribution":"The conduct is attributed to security forces and the State Security Prosecution; no personal presidential order is established.","limitations":["The source does not provide an official account of the dispersal or evidence of individual use of force."]},{"source_id":"SRC-63564b5434ef3b9b","start_unit":17,"end_unit":17,"fact_summary":"After President Sisi called for demonstrations supporting Palestinians and opposing forced displacement, security forces arrested 56 demonstrators in Cairo and Alexandria on 20 October 2023; prosecutors charged them with terrorism, vandalism, and unlawful assembly.","question_ids":["3B.5","3B.8","3B.9","4B.3","4B.9","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The presidential call and arrests occurred on 20 October 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Sisi's public call is directly reported; the arrests and prosecutions are attributed to security and judicial authorities, creating a documented divergence between rhetoric and implementation.","limitations":["The source does not establish whether Sisi knew of or authorized the arrests."]},{"source_id":"SRC-63564b5434ef3b9b","start_unit":17,"end_unit":17,"fact_summary":"Hundreds of displaced residents in North Sinai demonstrated in October 2023 for the right to return to their lands; the army used gunfire and other force to disperse them, detained protesters, and continued military-court proceedings against detainees.","question_ids":["2B.4","3B.6","3B.8","3B.9","4B.3","4B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The demonstrations, dispersal, arrests, and military proceedings began during 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The report attributes the actions to the Egyptian army and security authorities; it does not establish Sisi's personal operational order.","limitations":["The account is based on AFTE and Sinai human-rights reporting and does not include an official army response."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":[],"batch_limitations":["The supplied document is an advocacy and monitoring report focused on freedom of expression and related rights; it contains little direct evidence for nuclear risk, international peace, macroeconomic policy, social-service delivery, or personal financial integrity.","Most facts concern conduct by Egyptian state, security, judicial, regulatory, university, or military institutions. The document often does not establish President Sisi's personal knowledge, authorization, or control over each institutional act.","The report's factual basis includes AFTE databases, testimonies, legal records, and cited secondary sources; several allegations are reported without an independent adjudication in the supplied text."]}
